text: Recital 133 AI Act provides examples of marking techniques to include watermarks, metadata identifications, cryptographic methods for proving provenance and authenticity of content, logging methods, fingerprints or other techniques, and a combination of such techniques. Providers are not required to record or keep a full provenance chain, but such provenance methods may be used for compliance with Article 50(2) and can be conducive to enabling natural persons to distinguish AI-generated or manipulated content.
